**Addendum — which tree the verifier actually read.**

My previous comment said the findings came from `ref=d5c325a4170`. They did not. The MCP workspace at `/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code` was checked out at `8f7417079a` (2026-09-19 02:18 UTC), 28.5 hours behind `main`, and every completion run read that tree regardless of the `ref` passed. Change 2993's merge commit `9f67fcfef7a` is **not** an ancestor of `8f7417079a`, so the verifier could not see this ticket's fix at all. Filed on `working-carnelian-bobwhite` (8806-198c) with the measurements.

**The conclusion is unchanged, and I re-confirmed it directly rather than relying on the verifier.** Against the current tip of `main`:

```
git show origin/main:docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md | grep -n 'pyproject.toml\|required-version'
(no matches)
```

Neither `pyproject.toml` nor `required-version` appears anywhere in the file at `origin/main`, so criterion c01 — the doc must cite `pyproject.toml:353-356` as the source of the `==0.12.7` uv pin — is genuinely unmet and the remediation in flight is still required.

Net: the FAIL verdict was right, its stated reasoning was about the wrong tree, and the underlying gap is real. I will re-verify with `ref=origin/main` once the follow-up change merges.
